Check 4.2 – Completeness of the sight
Check 4.3 – Sight installation quality
Check 4.4 – Deviation of checking platform
Check 4.5 – Power supply to the sight
Check 4.6 – Insulation resistance of electric circuit
Check 4.7 – Hermicity of the sight
Check 4.8 – Direction of the line of sight
Check 4.9 – Matching of the sight bearing dials with gyro compass
Check 4.10 – Matching of the sight's own course indicator
Check 4.11 – Working of Training and Elevation
Check 4.12 – Clarity of field vision
Check 4.13 – Lighting of angular grid marking
Check 4.14 – Dial lighting
Check 4.15 – Working of elevation mechanism
Check 4.16 – Working of Training mechanism
Check 4.17 – Working of mechanism
Check 4.18 – Working of Glass wiper
Check 4.19 – Contact resistance should be: Max 600 μΩ – between the sight body and earthing element; Max 600 μΩ – between the remote unit and the element
TI Operational Checks:-
Operate the zoom controls Zoom Out and Zoom In
Operate the Focus controls Focus Far and Focus Near
Operate the BLK/ WHT HOT push button switch and observe the video polarity changes
Operate the RET B/W button and observe the polarity of the reticule changes
Operate the RET ON/ OFF button and observe that the reticule is displayed ON & OFF
